what_happened.line: School and police staff presented the ALICE program to the School Committee as an alternative to a straight lockdown; no vote was taken.
A community forum on ALICE was set for April 30, 2014, with two days of staff training planned for the start of next school year.
Communication upgrades, including merging the phone and intercom systems at the middle school, were already in the capital plan.
A contractor was asked for budget numbers on cameras at the primary and middle schools, with middle school cameras to come last.
Lock boxes for police access would be added to all school buildings, and state financing was hoped for upgrades beyond the capital plan.

why_it_matters: The security upgrades (phones, intercoms, cameras and lock boxes) would be paid through the capital plan, so their costs could reach residents as capital spending decisions and as a possible state-funding request.
The cost figures for cameras are not yet known, and no vote was taken, so the spending is still at the planning stage.
